name: Swiss pensions of someone living in Italy: the source tax is refunded under the treaty
workings: Living in Italy from 2026. Under Art. 18 of the Italy-Switzerland treaty Italy alone taxes BVG annuities and lump sums of its residents (at 5%, the it system's concern): Switzerland pays the annuity without source tax once residence is shown and refunds the source tax on the lump sum, so no Swiss tax is final.
The AHV pension isn't taxed at source at all.
No lines; a warning for each pension that its taxedIn should be residence.
